name: eq_zero_of_petersson_restrict_eq_zero
summary: Take g = ω. If y is orthogonal to all restrictions, the Poincaré-series periods (the kernels of φ) show that y is small near every point where the first minimum is large, by the Laplace-method lower bound H; near the cusp y is small by the cusp-step bound; a halving argument then gives y = 0.

steps.claim: Choose for every w the point ω(w), the bound c and the lower bound H.
steps.lean: choose ω c H using H

steps.claim: e is reflexivity (t = s ⊕ 1); 16 ≤ β (from hβ); the type of l is a cusp kernel (`isCuspKernel_typeKernel`, hg).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨rfl, b : 16 ≤ β, ke⟩ := e, hβ.trans' (mod_cast by lia), isCuspKernel_typeKernel hg

steps.claim: β ≤ m (from hm) and 2 ≤ β.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨bm : β ≤ m, r : 2 ≤ β⟩ := by grw [← hm]; bound, by bound

steps.claim: Let v be the volume of the unit ball {r : ‖r − 1‖ ≤ 1} of the real unitary group.
steps.lean: set v := Measure.real ..

steps.claim: Pointwise bounds of the coefficients (`norm_dsCoeff_le_pow`, p) and tail integrals (`integral_tail_le`, I, J).
steps.lean:
choose p I J using fun w ↦ And.intro (norm_dsCoeff_le_pow (hg w) (by bound))
    (integral_tail_le (hl w) (2 * A) (by lia))

steps.claim: v > 0; the product of the coefficients is integrable; and the product of the tail integrals is at most m/(16β)/(β^N(2β)^{3A})^f (by hm, hβ and the size bounds).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨_, _ : 0 < v, I : Integrable _ volume, J⟩ := b.trans bm, ENNReal.toReal_pos
    (measure_sublevel_ne_zero _) (measure_ball_ne_top_of_isProperMap _ .monoidHom_id _),
    .fintype_prod I, ((integral_fintype_prod_volume_eq_prod _).trans_le
    (prod_le_prod₀ (by delta formalDegree; positivity [·, ·]) fun w _ ↦ J w)).trans (c :=
    m / (16 * β) / (β ^ N * (2 * β) ^ (3 * A)) ^ D.f) (by
    grw [← hm, hβ, b, (by bound : 8 ≤ β), r]
    simp [field, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add, ← pow_succ', ← sq]; gcongr <;> nlinarith)

steps.claim: Take g = ω. For y of level chosenLevel (hK) orthogonal to the restrictions (h0): by the halving argument (`le_of_halving`, with the bound of y), it suffices that at every point either ‖y‖ is at most half the current bound or bounded by the cusp-step bound (`Space.IsForm.norm_le_of_firstMinimum_lt`, when the first minimum at the point is small); the case of a large first minimum remains.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨ω, fun ⟨y, hy⟩ hK h0 ↦ have k a (h : _ ∣ a) :=
      (mem_levelSpace_formRep_iff.1 hK · <| D.principalLevel_le_chosenLevel h ·)
    funext (norm_le_zero_iff.1 <| le_of_halving hy.2.choose_spec le_rfl (fun S _ hS x ↦ .inl
    ((le_or_gt ..).elim (fun z ↦ ?_)
      (IsForm.norm_le_of_firstMinimum_lt hy ke P.cycloConductor_mem_different NeZero.out (k _ ⟨_,
    D.piGBar_mul_star.symm⟩) (δ := m⁻¹ ^ 2) (by bound) (by bound) · fun u h ↦ ?_))) ·)⟩

steps.claim: Large first minimum:
steps.lean:
· have F α := (norm_poincare_period_sub_le hy.1 hS Fact.out (k _ D.piGBar_dvd_gridLevelGen) hR hA'
      hA hg' (by bound) x (by
      grw [← z, hc, bm] <;> simp [field, div_pow, NeZero.pos, (one_le_cuspConst ..).trans_lt']
      ring_nf; rfl) (fβ.trans bm) (by bound) ω α).imp_right (·.trans_eq' (congrArg (‖· - _‖)
      ((exists_kernel_form _ (isCuspKernel_typeKernel hg') (G.sum (x, 1) * (α, 1))⁻¹ _).elim fun Q
      hQ ↦ by simpa [↓conj_petersson, hQ, petersson, tsum_mul_left, ↓tsum_mul_right] using!
      congrArg conj (h0 _ Q.2))))
    have T := (congrArg _ (integral_mul_realConv hy.isBoundedMeasurable (F ω).1 ke.1.2
      (x * ⟨·, 1⟩))).ge.trans (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
      (I.mul_const (((2 * β) ^ (3 * A) * v) ^ D.f * S * 10 / m)) (.of_forall fun u ↦ ?_))
    · simp_rw [hy.realConv_translate ke, ← mul_assoc, integral_mul_const, norm_mul] at T
      nth_grw 1 [J, (congrArg _ (funext ?_)).trans (integral_fintype_prod_volume_eq_prod _)] at T
      grw [norm_prod, ← (div_le_iff₀' (by bound)).2 (H _)] at T
      simp [field, mul_pow] at T; nlinarith
      simp [field]
    obtain ⟨F, _⟩ := (F (inl .. ∘ u * ω)).2, (le_prod_opNorm u).1
    rw [realConv, ← integral_mul_left_eq_self _ u] at F
    simp [measureReal_pos_of_isLevel, realConv, Subgroup.coe_mul] at F ⊢
    grw [F, p, b, norm_mul_le]; simp [← sq]; grw [c]
    simp [field, div_pow, prod_pow, one_le_norm]; linear_combination

steps.claim: the Poincaré-series period of y (`norm_poincare_period_sub_le`, with hR, hA′, hA, hg′) differs from the period of y against the kernel form of φ (`Space.exists_kernel_form`) by a small amount, and the latter vanishes by h0;
steps.lean:
have F α := (norm_poincare_period_sub_le hy.1 hS Fact.out (k _ D.piGBar_dvd_gridLevelGen) hR hA'
      hA hg' (by bound) x (by
      grw [← z, hc, bm] <;> simp [field, div_pow, NeZero.pos, (one_le_cuspConst ..).trans_lt']
      ring_nf; rfl) (fβ.trans bm) (by bound) ω α).imp_right (·.trans_eq' (congrArg (‖· - _‖)
      ((exists_kernel_form _ (isCuspKernel_typeKernel hg') (G.sum (x, 1) * (α, 1))⁻¹ _).elim fun Q
      hQ ↦ by simpa [↓conj_petersson, hQ, petersson, tsum_mul_left, ↓tsum_mul_right] using!
      congrArg conj (h0 _ Q.2))))

steps.claim: the real convolution identity (`integral_mul_realConv`) and the norm bound of the integral of the coefficient product (T);
steps.lean:
have T := (congrArg _ (integral_mul_realConv hy.isBoundedMeasurable (F ω).1 ke.1.2
      (x * ⟨·, 1⟩))).ge.trans (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
      (I.mul_const (((2 * β) ^ (3 * A) * v) ^ D.f * S * 10 / m)) (.of_forall fun u ↦ ?_))

steps.claim: translate y and insert the product formula of the integral and the lower bound H into T: the value of y at the point is at most half the current bound;
steps.lean:
· simp_rw [hy.realConv_translate ke, ← mul_assoc, integral_mul_const, norm_mul] at T
      nth_grw 1 [J, (congrArg _ (funext ?_)).trans (integral_fintype_prod_volume_eq_prod _)] at T
      grw [norm_prod, ← (div_le_iff₀' (by bound)).2 (H _)] at T
      simp [field, mul_pow] at T; nlinarith
      simp [field]

steps.claim: the bound for the translated coefficient (F at ω composed with u) and the operator norm of u;
steps.lean: obtain ⟨F, _⟩ := (F (inl .. ∘ u * ω)).2, (le_prod_opNorm u).1

steps.claim: rewrite F as an integral over the unitary group (right invariance);
steps.lean: rw [realConv, ← integral_mul_left_eq_self _ u] at F

steps.claim: positivity of the measure of the level and the form of the real convolution;
steps.lean: simp [measureReal_pos_of_isLevel, realConv, Subgroup.coe_mul] at F ⊢

steps.claim: the estimate with p, the size of β and the norm of products;
steps.lean: grw [F, p, b, norm_mul_le]; simp [← sq]; grw [c]

steps.claim: a polynomial inequality (linear combination).
steps.lean: simp [field, div_pow, prod_pow, one_le_norm]; linear_combination

steps.claim: Small first minimum: integrability of y times translates of the coefficient (j).
steps.lean: have j g := hy.isBoundedMeasurable.integrable_mul_comp ke.1.2 (g * ⟨·, 1⟩)

steps.claim: ‖y(gx) − y(g)‖ is bounded by the integral of the difference of translated coefficients (realConv twice, right invariance, the tail integral J).
steps.lean:
grw [← hy.3 ke.1.2, realConv, realConv, ← integral_mul_left_eq_self _ u⁻¹, ← integral_sub
    ((j _).comp_mul_left _) (j _), norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (((I.comp_mul_left u⁻¹).add
    I).mul_const (β / m * S)) (.of_forall fun r ↦ ?_), integral_mul_const, integral_add'
    (I.comp_mul_left _) I, (integral_mul_left_eq_self ..).trans_le J, J, div_le_self]

steps.claim: Clearing denominators; the bound is positive.
steps.lean: field_simp; linarith; any_goals bound

steps.claim: Factor the difference.
steps.lean: simp [← mul_sub, ← sub_mul, ← mul_add]

steps.claim: Insert the bound S of y.
steps.lean: grw [hS, ← mul_assoc]; gcongr

steps.claim: Square both sides: the difference of coefficients at r and at u⁻¹r is at most β·(β·m⁻²).
steps.lean: nth_grw 1 [← sq_le_sq₀, sq, (?_ : ‖_‖ ≤ β * (β * m⁻¹ ^ 2)), norm_sub_le]

steps.claim: Expand with the pointwise bounds p.
steps.lean: simp; grw [p, p, ← sub_nonneg]; simp_rw [prod_pow]; ring_nf

steps.claim: Positivity of the remaining quantities.
steps.lean: any_goals positivity

steps.claim: The norm of the difference of products of coefficients is bounded by the multilinear estimate (`ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_image_sub_le`).
steps.lean: apply ((ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra ℂ _ ℂ).norm_image_sub_le ..).trans

steps.claim: Monotonicity.
steps.lean: gcongr

steps.claim: The coefficients have norm at most 1 (`norm_dsCoeff_le_one`), and f ≤ β.
steps.lean: grw [fβ, pow_le_one₀] <;> simp [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonempty, norm_dsCoeff_le_one]

steps.claim: Rewrite the difference of coefficients via inverses.
steps.lean: simp_rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonempty, Pi.sub_apply, ← dsCoeff_inv, _root_.mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]

steps.claim: Introduce the place.
steps.lean: intro

steps.claim: The Lipschitz bound of the coefficients (`norm_dsCoeff_sub_le`) and the distance of u to 1 (≤ m⁻², from the hypothesis of the cusp step).
steps.lean: grw [norm_dsCoeff_sub_le (hl _), ← dist_eq_norm, ← hβ, ← h, ← dist_le_pi_dist u 1 ‹_›]; bound
